title: Genesis 3:4-5 — “You surely will not die… you will be like God”
summary: Genesis 3:4-5 in English: the serpent tells the woman she will not die, and that eating will open her eyes so she will be like God, knowing good and evil. The words “good” and “evil” are enlarged for emphasis.

text.text: 4 The serpent said to the woman, “You surely will not die!
5 “For God knows that in the day you eat from it your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”
